scope: Web/backend isolated fixtures. No native, production access, paid AI, deployment, database migration or commits.
interpretation: Work counts are records returned by synthetic adapters executing actual application functions, not physical database rows scanned or hosted latency.
Adapter tests execute actual file/PostgreSQL method bodies with isolated records and captured tagged-SQL calls. SQL shape is checked; no live PostgreSQL query plan measured.
Notebook byte counts are serialized adapter results before client summary mapping, not network response size. Client summaries are exactly equal.

The file adapter still reads/parses its full JSON store before filtering; these counts do not demonstrate reduced file-store disk I/O. PostgreSQL transport/decoding reductions follow the narrower selected records and fields, pending hosted measurement.

coverage.findings: Migration reads only project/projectSection/workboard mutations; project lookup reads only Projects. Checkpoint delta semantics retained. Hub uses projected Notebook summaries.
coverage.remaining: Migration still inventories owner links and answer IDs for deltas. Foundation returns complete linked artifacts. No cross-request cache added.

coverage.findings: Existing request-local owner/project lookup and revision reads are scoped; tests cover owner separation and historical/reference/deleted project identity.
PostgreSQL pull uses repeatable-read for deltas, project dependencies, latest cursor and entitlement; push retains existing serializable write path. Event indexes declared.
coverage.remaining: No live PostgreSQL concurrency or query-plan test. File store tests are not hosted performance evidence.

coverage.findings: List query omits editable document, evidence links, image IDs and save receipt, preserving client summary fields. Get/save replay and conflict paths scope links. Full edit payloads, version conflicts, replay recovery and session revocation retained.
coverage.remaining: List still returns all linked project summaries and existing full plainText; pagination/API changes deferred.

coverage.findings: Exact artifact IDs and request-local batched validation remove repeated inventories. Cross-project image access queries linked project cards. Owner/type/deleted/link rejection, cross-owner cache isolation, retry and later-request deletion tested.
coverage.remaining: Saved/note/workboard validation still loads owner mutations once; selected passages/approved evidence load owner conversations/answers once per validation. Orphan cleanup retains broad reference checks.

coverage.findings: Exact draft/manifest artifact and link filters; one shared source mutation snapshot preserves clear/tombstone and edition semantics. Export retains text, tables, notes, citation identities, immutable hashes and auth guards.
coverage.remaining: Draft/history lists stay project-wide. File read finds one file among project generated reports. Manifest authorization traverses candidate accessible projects. Remote blob latency unmeasured.

coverage.findings: BC68 label corrected to 1968 NYC Building Code using authored category; canonical package/version IDs and text unchanged. Historical Notebook and mixed-edition Report regression passes.

Cursor history uses compact summaries, owner/project binding, capped pages and declared visible-history indexes. Usage filters month and expires reservations after 15 minutes; file credit/reservation concurrency tests pass.
coverage.remaining: Credits retain owner ledger reads. Firm allowance fans out per active member. Live providers and generated-answer timing unmeasured.

coverage.findings: Schema declares primary artifact ID, owner/project link, owner/target link, history cursor, usage timestamp and sync-event indexes. Fixture counts alone do not justify another index. Neon client has no explicit application DB deadline.
coverage.remaining: Verify deployed index presence and representative staging plans/latency before adding indexes or deadline policy; driver/platform defaults unmeasured.

recommendation: Deploy server code changes through normal review after local acceptance, then measure authenticated staging routes and PostgreSQL plans. No database migration/configuration change was made or established as necessary.

fixtureRepairs.baseline: Exact e650a1c69 app, test and private-workspace-state module reproduced the line 112 failure in a temporary isolated harness.
fixtureRepairs.cause: The fixture assumed rendering blocks all dispatch. Existing nonblocking rendering dispatched an A-owned projectSection mutation synchronously before the account switch; no later mutation or B write occurred.
fixtureRepairs.repair: Capture and assert owner A for pre-switch dispatches, then require exact unchanged calls, AbortError and unchanged replacement state after A-to-B and A-to-B-to-A. Existing deferred-response, stale-token, queue and account recovery checks remain and pass.

broaderGateLimitations.baseline: Exact e650a1c69 app/test and changed server/public dependencies in an isolated mirror reproduce same failure. All provider responses mocked; no paid calls.
broaderGateLimitations.interpretation: Recorded replay fails citation-selection validation before semantic verification. This audit did not change routing or weaken the substantive gate. Full broad check is not claimed passing.
